The Problem

Most owner-led businesses are running on
memory, habits, and whoever picks up the phone.

It's not a motivation problem. It's an infrastructure problem. The business has outgrown the system it's running on.

Leads come in from 4 places and get lost.

Phone, web form, Instagram DM, referral — and no single place to see all of them. Some never get a response.

Follow-up happens when someone remembers.

There's no sequence, no trigger, no system. A prospect reaches out on Tuesday and hears back on Friday — if at all.

Everything lives in the owner's head.

There are no written SOPs. Staff ask the same questions every week. New hires take 3 months to feel productive.

The owner is the bottleneck for every decision.

Nothing gets approved without them. The business stops when they're unavailable. Vacation is not really a vacation.

No single place to see how the business is performing.

Revenue is in one tool. Tasks are in another. Leads somewhere else. The owner checks everything by gut feel.

Manual work that should run itself.

Appointment reminders sent by hand. Invoice follow-up done by memory. Recurring tasks that exist only because someone remembered.

If three or more of these sound familiar — your business needs an operating system.

The OwnerOS Audit shows you exactly where the gaps are and what to fix first.

The OwnerOS Method

Five phases. One clear path from chaos to operating system.

Every engagement follows the same structured approach. We don't start building until we fully understand how your business runs. We don't hand off until your team is trained and confident.

The result is a system you own completely — documented, trained into your team, and designed to keep improving over time.

1

Map

We document how your business actually runs today — lead flow, communication, tools, SOPs, and owner bottlenecks.

2

Score

We score your business using the OwnerOS Readiness Score across 10 dimensions from 0 to 100.

3

Build

We build the missing pieces — room by room — using tools you already have or can adopt easily.

4

Train

We train your team to use the system so it actually sticks. Documentation, videos, and live sessions.

5

Optimize

We review, improve, and expand monthly — so the system keeps working as your business grows.

Who We Help

Built for owner-led service businesses.

We focus on businesses where the owner is in the work every day and the operating infrastructure hasn't kept up with the growth.

💆

Med Spas

Leads come from Instagram DMs, web forms, phone calls, and referrals — and fall through constantly. Follow-up is manual. Appointment no-shows aren't followed up on. The owner is fielding every question.

🔨

Contractors & Remodelers

Estimates go out and disappear. Follow-up happens when someone remembers. There's no system for tracking where each job is. The owner is the only one who knows what's happening.

🦷

Dental Offices

Front desk is overwhelmed. New patient inquiries aren't followed up on consistently. Insurance verification takes forever. There's no SOP for how anything gets done.

🏠

Roofing & HVAC

Seasonal lead spikes are mismanaged. Estimates pile up with no follow-up system. Crews don't know where they're supposed to be. The owner is the dispatcher, salesperson, and QA manager.

⚖️

Law Firms

Intake is inconsistent. Prospective clients don't hear back fast enough. Matter status isn't visible to anyone but the partner. Billing follow-up is manual and awkward.

🏡

Real Estate Teams

Leads go cold fast. Every agent handles follow-up differently. There's no consistent client communication process. The team leader has no visibility into pipeline health.

🎓

Training Schools

Enrollment inquiries aren't followed up consistently. Student communication is scattered. Staff don't have standard answers to common questions. The director manages everything manually.

💼

Professional Services

Proposals go out and sit. Onboarding is different every time. Project status isn't visible. The owner is involved in every client question.
